# All Star Productions (أول ستار للإنتاج)

> Riyadh-based events, exhibitions and advertising company. One team handles event management, exhibition stand design and build, and advertising production: banner and sticker printing, shop signs, display stands, vehicle branding, branded workwear and corporate gifts. Produced in Riyadh and delivered across Saudi Arabia. The website is bilingual: English under /en, Arabic under /ar.

- Address: As Sanabel Street, As Salhiyah, Riyadh 12662, Saudi Arabia
- WhatsApp: +966 57 895 2076
- Hours: Saturday to Thursday, 9:00–21:00 (Arabia Standard Time)
- Google reviews: 5.0 from 24 reviews (November 2026): https://maps.google.com/?cid=10262380881990550896
- Prices are quoted per project; there is no public price list.
